parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const history = $('Fetch Conversation History').all().map(i => i.json); const allText = history.map(h => (h.incoming_message || '') + ' ' + (h.ai_response || '')).join(' ') + ' ' + ($json.incomingMessage || ''); let email = null; const emailMatch = allText.match(/[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i); if (emailMatch) email = emailMatch[0]; let address = null; history.forEach(h => { if (!address && h.incoming_message) { const addrMatch = h.incoming_message.match(/\d+\s+\w+\s+(?:road|street|avenue|drive|place|close|blvd)\s*,?\s*\w+/i); if (addrMatch) address = addrMatch[0]; } }); let recommendedPackage = null; history.forEach(h => { if (!recommendedPackage && h.ai_response) { const pkgMatch = h.ai_response.match(/(\d+\/?\d*\s*Mbps[^]*?R\d+\/month)/i); if (pkgMatch) recommendedPackage = pkgMatch[0]; } }); return { phone_number: $json.phoneNumber, full_name: $json.contactName, email: email, physical_address: address, recommended_package: recommendedPackage, lead_score: $json.leadScore, follow_up_requested: $json.followUpRequested, follow_up_date: $json.followUpDate, needs_escalation: $json.needsEscalation, offered_package: recommendedPackage }; })()) }}

⚠️ Layla WhatsApp Bot Error

The Inbound AI Lead Qualification workflow failed

Error Details

Workflow:${workflowName}
Failed Node:${nodeName}
Error:${errorMsg}
Execution ID:${executionId}
Time:${timestamp}

Stack Trace

${stack.substring(0, 2000)}

Action Required

  • Check the workflow execution: Open n8n Workflow
  • Layla is NOT responding to WhatsApp messages while this error persists
  • Review the failed node and fix the issue
  • Re-publish the workflow after fixing

This alert was sent by the n8n Error Trigger on the Inbound AI workflow

`; return { json: { sender: { name: 'Horizon Africa Alerts', email: 'keshlan@horizonafrica.co.za' }, to: [{ email: 'sifosman@gmail.com', name: 'Sif' }, { email: 'keshlan@horizonafrica.co.za', name: 'Keshlan' }], subject: '⚠️ Layla WhatsApp Bot Error - ' + errorMsg.substring(0, 60), htmlContent: htmlContent } };
